about: Plain-language symptom queries, one per trap per split, written from the user's side rather than copied from entry text. Tune matcher changes on the 'tune' split only; report the 'holdout' split. Negatives (also split tune/holdout) are off-domain and must return NOT_DOCUMENTED.
